designTitle: 刃走りの金属光 ― オリハルコン通常斬り R7
design: R7 keeps one physical empty swing and replaces the broad orange fan read with a brighter, narrow tapered blade-tip trace, clearer pale/dark metal faces, and a bounded traveling reflection driven by the existing sword-mounted light. It preserves geometry, pose, timing, the two source facets, roof-source integration, hand illumination, controls, SFX and event semantics; no contact, target, guard, enhancement, GBO or EC wave is depicted.
emissionContract: Blade-tip trace and metallic blade-face emission remain tied to the two existing sword-mounted facets and existing swing envelope. Reflected response is bounded to the blade, sword hand, and immediately adjacent material; no extra emitter, pass, bloom, texture, or whole-person glow.
observationPlan: Use the public R7 parent in verify mode at default H64 size. Record CSS/buffer dimensions and device scale. Observe an ordinary enhance-0 empty swing at normal speed; do not infer absent short flashes from 0.5-second snapshots.

At same display size, inspect the physical blade outline, blade-tip trace, metal face contrast and near hand response separately. Confirm the trail follows the blade tip and does not read as a broad fan or detached projectile.

Compare the established source-off / reduced controls at matching event age and facing. Check that source emission and nearby reflection turn off together while figure, blade geometry, trigger, timing and SFX remain unchanged.

Verify idle, visible-off, both facings, normal empty swing, recovery and end-of-lifetime; preserve R6 fixture rest and ensure no residual glow after 980 ms. This is a test plan, not a quality acceptance claim.
minimumEmissionAcceptance: At actual H64 display size, the blade and its short trace must read as luminous metal, with a visible but local reflection on adjacent sword/hand material. A code-level intensity increase or enlarged crop alone is not acceptance.
